entries.Translated: 采集时使用陆行鸟搭档

entries.Original: Auto-switch to Healer stance when HP is low
entries.Translated: HP 过低时自动切换为治疗姿态
切换为治疗的 HP 百分比 %%

entries.Original: Auto re-use Gysahl Greens before companion times out
entries.Translated: 搭档超时前自动重新使用基萨尔野菜
计时低于 (秒) 时重新召唤

entries.Original: Lifestream command to reach your house/apartment for stabling, e.g. '/li home', '/li apartment', '/li fc'.
entries.Translated: 用于前往房屋/公寓进行寄养的 Lifestream 命令，例如 '/li home'、'/li apartment'、'/li fc'。

entries.Original: Target your chocobo stable in-game, then click below to capture it.
entries.Translated: 在游戏内选中你的陆行鸟鸟房，然后点击下方进行捕获。

entries.Original: [Autofate] No target. Click your chocobo stable first, then press this.
entries.Translated: [Autofate] 没有目标。请先点击你的陆行鸟鸟房，然后按此按钮。

entries.Original: Pick which plugin handles your damage rotation. If a selected plugin isn't installed, Autofate will refuse to start and tell you in chat.
entries.Translated: 选择由哪个插件处理你的输出循环。如果所选插件未安装，Autofate 将拒绝启动并在聊天中提示你。

entries.Original: Automatically re-apply food and combat potions before they expire. Only items currently in your inventory are listed.
entries.Translated: 在食物和战斗药水过期前自动重新使用。仅列出当前背包中已有的物品。
增益低于 (秒) 时重新使用

entries.Original: Tune how the plugin picks and runs FATEs. Use the blacklist below to skip specific FATEs.
entries.Translated: 调整插件挑选和执行 FATE 的方式。使用下方黑名单跳过特定 FATE。

entries.Original: Levels above player to still run
Skip FATEs more than this many levels above your current level. Default 2.
entries.Translated: 跳过高于当前等级超过此数值的 FATE。默认 2。

entries.Original: Ignore FATEs with less than this many seconds left on their timer.
entries.Translated: 忽略计时器剩余时间少于此秒数的 FATE。

entries.Original: In multi-zone modes, how long to wait for FATEs to respawn in a zone before rotating to another zone. FATEs pop every few minutes, so keep this high (e.g. 240) to avoid teleport-hopping. 0 = never rotate (stay in one zone forever).
entries.Translated: 在多区域模式下，等待区域内 FATE 重生多久后切换到其他区域。FATE 每隔几分钟刷新，因此请保持较高数值（例如 240）以避免频繁传送。0 = 永不切换（永远停留在一个区域）。

entries.Original: Prioritize FATEs lower on their timer (over closest)
entries.Translated: 优先选择计时器剩余时间更少的 FATE（而非最近的）

entries.Original: Auto level-sync to the target FATE
entries.Translated: 自动等级同步至目标 FATE

entries.Original: Only syncs once you arrive inside the target FATE, so you don't sync to fates you pass through.
entries.Translated: 仅在抵达目标 FATE 内后才同步，这样不会同步到路过的 FATE。

entries.Original: Max enemies to hold at once
Follow party leader (don't navigate to fates)
entries.Translated: 跟随小队队长（不导航至 FATE）

entries.Original: Instead of picking and pathing to our own FATEs, just follow the party leader and run whatever FATE they drop us in. Good for multiboxing or farming with friends. Uses BossMod's native follow when BossMod handles movement, otherwise vnavmesh.
entries.Translated: 不自行挑选和前往 FATE，而是跟随小队队长并执行其进入的任意 FATE。适合多开或与好友刷怪。当 BossMod 处理移动时使用其原生跟随，否则使用 vnavmesh。
本次会话已见（点击加入黑名单）：

entries.Original: Spend bicolor gemstones at a vendor automatically. When you reach the threshold, Autofate buys your list. Open the gemstone vendor to import its offerings.
entries.Translated: 自动在商人处消耗双色宝石。达到阈值时，Autofate 会购买你的清单。打开宝石商人以导入其商品。
当晶石达到以下数量时购买

entries.Original: Autofate heads to the vendor once you hold at least this many bicolor gemstones.
entries.Translated: 当持有的双色晶石达到此数量时，Autofate 会前往商人处。

entries.Original: — will teleport to the nearest aetheryte.
entries.Translated: — 将传送至最近的以太之光。

entries.Original: Vendor zone not set — add an item below while the vendor is open to capture it.
entries.Translated: 未设置商人区域 — 在商人界面打开时于下方添加物品即可捕获。

entries.Original: Vendor is open — add items it sells:
entries.Translated: 商人界面已打开 — 添加其出售的物品：

entries.Original: Open the bicolor gemstone vendor in-game to import its item list here.
entries.Translated: 在游戏中打开双色晶石商人界面，即可将其物品列表导入此处。

entries.Original: Choose what kind of FATE farming to do.
entries.Translated: 选择要进行的 FATE 刷取类型。

entries.Original: Farms FATEs in the best zone for your level. The slider caps which zone we farm in: set it to 50 and we stay in the level-50 zone even past 50. Stopping at a target level is set separately in the Stop Triggers tab.
entries.Translated: 在你等级最适合的区域刷取 FATE。滑块限制刷取区域：设为 50 时，即使超过 50 级也会停留在 50 级区域。在目标等级停止需在停止触发器标签页中单独设置。

entries.Original: Farms FATEs in a single zone.

Shared FATEs are the FATEs in Shadowbringers, Endwalker, and Dawntrail overworld zones. The plugin rotates through these zones and can use the in-game Shared FATE tracker to skip/stop zones once their rank is maxed.
entries.Translated: 共享 FATE 是 Shadowbringers -暗影使者-、晓月之终途和 Dawntrail -曦光旅路- 野外区域中的 FATE。插件会在这些区域间轮换，并可使用游戏内的共享 FATE 追踪器在区域等级满后跳过/停止该区域。

entries.Original: Select at least one expansion or there will be no zones to farm.
entries.Translated: 至少选择一个资料片，否则将没有可刷取的区域。

entries.Original: Skip zones whose shared-fate rank is maxed
entries.Translated: 跳过共享 FATE 等级已满的区域

entries.Original: Stop farming when ALL shared-fate zones are maxed
entries.Translated: 当所有共享 FATE 区域都满级时停止刷取

entries.Original: Shared FATE tracker data not loaded yet.
entries.Translated: 共享 FATE 追踪器数据尚未加载。

entries.Original: Opens the in-game Shared FATE window briefly to populate rank/progress data. This happens automatically while farming in this mode.
entries.Translated: 短暂打开游戏内的共享 FATE 窗口以填充等级/进度数据。在此模式下刷取时会自动进行。
已选择共享 FATE 区域 (仅名称)：

entries.Original: Tracks these collectables in your inventory. When a zone's items are all collected it moves on; when the whole list is done it stops.
entries.Translated: 追踪你背包中的这些收藏品。当一个区域内的物品全部收集完毕后会自动切换；整个列表完成后停止。

entries.Original: Build a custom list of zones, set how many fates to run in each, and optionally loop the list.
entries.Translated: 自定义区域列表，设置每个区域要执行的 FATE 数量，并可选择循环列表。
耐久度低于 (%%) 时修理

entries.Original: No Dark Matter! Farming will stop if repair is needed.
entries.Translated: 没有暗物质！需要修理时采集将停止。

entries.Original: Install/enable the missing plugin (see detection list below), then press START again.
entries.Translated: 安装/启用缺失的插件（见下方检测列表），然后再次按 START。

entries.Original: Logs detailed diagnostics to the Dalamud log (/xllog): fate selection, plus [Diag/...] lines for NPC interaction, combat targeting/movement, collect, and escort. Use when reporting a stuck/loop bug.
entries.Translated: 将详细诊断信息记录到 Dalamud 日志 (/xllog)：FATE 选择，以及 NPC 任务指令、战斗选定目标/移动、收藏品采集和护送相关的 [Diag/...] 行。在报告卡住/循环 bug 时使用。

entries.Original: Resets everything, including mount, food/potion, gemstone vendor, and stable setup.
entries.Translated: 重置所有内容，包括坐骑、食物/药水、神典石商人以及鸟棚设置。

entries.Original: Automatically stop farming when one of these conditions is met.
entries.Translated: 满足以下任一条件时自动停止刷取。

entries.Original: Stop at gemstone count (gross gained this session)
entries.Translated: 达到神典石数量时停止（本次会话总获取量）
本次会话总获取神典石：

entries.Original: Stop when chocobo reaches target level
entries.Translated: 陆行鸟达到目标等级时停止

entries.Original: Stop when gemstone buy-list targets are all met
entries.Translated: 神典石购买清单目标全部达成时停止

entries.Original: Only counts if every enabled buy-list entry has a fixed target quantity (not continuous).
entries.Translated: 仅当所有已启用的购买清单条目都设定了固定目标数量（非持续）时才计数。

entries.Original: How Autofate gets around. Long-distance travel uses vnavmesh; between-zone travel uses Lifestream (or teleport).
entries.Translated: Autofate 的移动方式。远距离移动使用 vnavmesh；跨区域移动使用 Lifestream（或传送）。

entries.Original: Use a mount for long-distance travel
entries.Translated: 远距离移动时使用坐骑

entries.Original: Mount if destination is farther than (yalms)
entries.Translated: 目的地距离超过（星码）时使用坐骑

entries.Original: Use Lifestream for teleporting between zones
entries.Translated: 跨区域传送时使用 Lifestream

entries.Original: Run a Lifestream command when farming finishes
entries.Translated: 刷取结束时执行 Lifestream 命令

entries.Original: e.g. '/li home' or '/li <aetheryte>'. Runs after the plugin stops.
entries.Translated: 例如 '/li home' 或 '/li <aetheryte>'。插件停止后执行。

entries.Original: [Autofate] Couldn't find the chocobo stable nearby. Target your stable in-game and click 'Add targeted stable' in the Chocobo tab.
entries.Translated: [Autofate] 附近找不到陆行鸟鸟棚。请在游戏内选中你的鸟棚，然后在陆行鸟标签页点击“添加选中的鸟棚”。
开始 — 先购买神典石物品...

entries.Original: [Autofate] Farming started — buying gemstone items first.
entries.Translated: [Autofate] 刷取已开始 — 先购买神典石物品。

entries.Original: [Autofate] Died more than twice in leveling mode — stopping.
entries.Translated: [Autofate] 练级模式下死亡超过两次 — 停止。

entries.Original: [Autofate] Out of dark matter for self-repair. Stopping.
entries.Translated: [Autofate] 自我修理所需暗物质不足。停止。

entries.Original: [Autofate] No zones configured for this mode.
entries.Translated: [Autofate] 此模式未配置任何区域。

entries.Original: Waiting for a possible replacement FATE...
Waiting to land before talking to

entries.Translated: 收藏品采集：采集前清理战斗
清理仇恨前搭乘/下坐骑

entries.Original: Follow: leader object not loaded (out of range?)
entries.Translated: 跟随：队长对象未加载（超出范围？）

entries.Original: [Autofate] NPC repair not yet automated; switch to self-repair.
entries.Translated: [Autofate] NPC修理尚未自动化；切换为自行修理。

entries.Original: [Autofate] Open the gemstone vendor and click 'Add' on an item in the Gemstone tab to capture its location for auto-travel.
entries.Translated: [Autofate] 打开神典石商人，在神典石标签页中点击物品上的“添加”以捕获其位置用于自动前往。
正在前往神典石商人，位于

entries.Original: [Autofate] Reached the vendor spot but couldn't find the vendor NPC. Re-capture it in the Gemstone tab.
entries.Translated: [Autofate] 已到达商人位置，但找不到商人NPC。请在神典石标签页中重新捕获。
